verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Status Pages are documented as giving real-time visibility into incident resolution status (pagerduty-docs-10), and as a way to proactively communicate operational updates from inside PagerDuty without switching tools (pagerduty-docs-17). That covers the core of pushing structured updates to people outside the response team. However, the evidence never shows stakeholder subscriptions, and never says these pages can be internal or private rather than public. Missing for 10: stakeholder subscription and notification mechanism, internal/private stakeholder audiences, structured update templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
